row_schema.description: One row per qualifying race per lane. Append-only. Primary key: lane_id + race_id.

fields.name: lane_condition
fields.note: human-readable condition that qualified this row

fields.name: signal_value
fields.note: the key signal value that triggered the lane (MDS, improve_score, VP, etc)

fields.name: sp_decimal
fields.note: starting price decimal at race time

fields.name: missed_winner_sp
fields.note: SP of actual winner if missed

fields.name: sidecar_sources
fields.note: list of sidecars that also fired: MDS_HIGH | IMPROVE_HIGH | PLACE_HIGH

row_schema.dedup_rule: If race_id already exists for a lane_id, skip — do not overwrite.

running_stats_schema.description: Per-lane running stats, recomputed after every append batch.

fields.name: roi_research
fields.note: level-stake ROI at SP — research only, not operational

fields.name: avg_signal_value
fields.note: avg of the lane trigger value

fields.name: consecutive_weak_days
fields.note: days with SR=0 in a row

lanes.description: Races where velo_prime_prob >= 0.30 AND decision_tier == 'A'. The primary live signal gate.

promotion_gates.notes: n=250 gives statistical stability. SR floor is set below current 40.1% to allow for natural variance.

freeze_rules.auto_freeze_if: SR < 0.20 at n >= 50 OR frame_rate < 0.55 at n >= 50
freeze_rules.unfreeze_condition: operator review + SR recovery above floor

lanes.description: Races where market_deception_score > 0.50. POLARITY FLIP CONFIRMED: previously used as a decoy blocker. 49-day audit shows SR=54.8%, Frame=96.8% — this signal identifies live contenders the market shape is disguising. Highest upside signal in the system.

baseline_evidence.warning: n=31 — elite signal but small sample. Treat with discipline.

promotion_gates.notes: Lower n gate (75 vs 250) because the signal is extreme. If SR holds above 40% at n=75 this warrants urgent human review. Extra caution: if SR drops below 30% at n=50, freeze immediately — extreme signals that regress can indicate overfitting.

freeze_rules.auto_freeze_if: SR < 0.25 at n >= 40 OR frame_rate < 0.65 at n >= 40
freeze_rules.polarity_watch: If SR falls below global baseline (20.6%), the polarity flip hypothesis fails — escalate immediately.
freeze_rules.unfreeze_condition: operator review — do not auto-unfreeze this lane

lanes.description: Races where improvement_score > 0.40. Captures horses showing progressive form improvement.

promotion_gates.notes: n=62 at baseline. Need 100 to confirm. SR floor set below current 43.5% to allow variance.

freeze_rules.auto_freeze_if: SR < 0.22 at n >= 60 OR frame_rate < 0.60 at n >= 60
freeze_rules.unfreeze_condition: operator review + SR recovery above floor

lanes.description: Races where place_prob > 0.80. Large sample signal (n=392). SR=31.6% is meaningful but requires VP or Tier A overlay before candidate promotion. Currently WATCHLIST — not yet a shadow candidate.

promotion_gates.overlay_required: VP >= 0.30 OR decision_tier == 'A' required before SHADOW_CANDIDATE promotion
promotion_gates.notes: Place probability alone is not enough — it is measuring a different dimension than VP. Only valid as a shadow candidate when combined with VP≥0.30 or Tier A. Track volume at n=392 is the highest in the system — watch for sample dilution.

freeze_rules.auto_freeze_if: SR < 0.18 at n >= 200 OR frame_rate < 0.50 at n >= 200

lanes.description: Races where decision_tier == 'B' AND velo_prime_prob < 0.30. SR=16.9%, Frame=44.1% — confirmed drag on global metrics. Suppression test: removing these 272 races improves global SR from 20.6% → 21.6% at a coverage cost of -21.8%. Tracking to confirm drag persists before suppression protocol.

baseline_evidence.suppression_gain: +1.0% global SR, +1.2% global frame at -21.8% coverage

suppression_review_gates.notes: If SR remains below 18% and frame below 50% at n=350, suppression protocol is warranted. Present evidence to operator for decision. Do NOT auto-suppress — this is a coverage reduction and requires explicit approval.

recovery_gates.notes: If SR recovers, re-classify as WATCHLIST and hold suppression.

freeze_rules.notes: Suppress candidates do not freeze — they accumulate evidence towards a suppression decision.

lanes.description: Races where VÉLØ missed and the actual winner had SP between 3.0 and 8.5. 352 misses = 58% of all misses across 49 days. This is the primary unsolved problem. No scoring function. No execution target. Research only.
research_questions: 1. SP clustering — where within 3.0–8.5 do misses concentrate? (3.0–4.5 vs 5.0–8.5?)
2. VP distribution — what VP score did VÉLØ assign to these races when it missed?
3. Tier distribution — are mid-price winner misses concentrated in Tier B/C?
4. Race type distribution — flat vs jump? Class 3/4/5 split?
5. Course/distance pattern — do certain tracks produce more mid-price winner misses?
6. Time of meeting — do mid-price winner misses cluster in later races?
lanes.forensics_goal: Determine whether VÉLØ is systematically underweighting mid-price contenders, or whether this is irreducible noise at 3.0–8.5 SP. If systematic, identify which feature or model component is responsible.
lanes.promotion_path: NONE — forensics only. Cannot be promoted to a shadow candidate.
lanes.ledger_note: Forensics ledger captures MISS rows in SP 3.0–8.5 zone. Each row has the full miss context for pattern analysis.

principles: All ledgers are append-only. No row is ever deleted or modified after writing.
A race qualifies for a lane when it meets the lane condition at the time of prediction.
Lane qualification is determined from sigma_audit rows (post-result), not from racecard.
Signal values (MDS, improve_score, VP) come from velo_verdicts or verdict JSON — not recalculated.
Ledger rows are written by the shadow ledger append script after each sigma batch.
No staking or betting decision is ever derived from ledger state.
No lane can be promoted without explicit operator approval.

stages: DESIGN (current) — lane defined, schema specified, no live rows
SHADOW_CANDIDATE — live rows accumulating, no execution
WATCHLIST — n gate passed, SR/Frame reviewed, watching for stability
PAPER_EXECUTION — operator tracks as if executing, still no staking
LIVE_DISCUSSION — sustained evidence, operator review for live activation
LIVE_ACTIVATION — explicit operator approval, full audit trail required

append_script.name: scripts/run_candidate_lane_shadow_append.py
append_script.purpose: Reads today's sigma results, evaluates each lane condition, appends qualifying rows to ledger CSVs.

storage.primary: data/shadow_ledgers/ — CSV files, one per lane
storage.supabase_path: FUTURE — table candidate_lane_shadow_rows if/when DB schema approved

hard_rules: NO staking or betting based on ledger state.
NO router rule changes from ledger observations.
NO model training based on ledger patterns.
